turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
What went through your mind then?
I have a property law exam in two weeks and I am not sleeping.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Tell me more about that.
I threw away the scale yesterday, but I wanted to take it out of the bin straight afterwards.
Mm-hm. Go on.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. I keep coming back to it.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The GP referred me to the student eating disorder service and the first appointment is the third of February.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. It is not easy to talk about.
What happened next?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
My mother is much gentler than my father, she sends me soup recipes and says nothing about weight.
Take your time.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. It is not easy to talk about.
Mm-hm. Go on.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
